task.description: Diagnose ISS-0130 / GH #423: confirm or correct the stated root cause (stale search_path on reused pool connection racing GBL-112 dropped users/user_roles tables) by reading the migration runner, pool, and provisioning code, and attempt empirical reproduction of RT-1/RT-2 intermittent C42P01 failures.
acceptance_criteria: Root cause confirmed or corrected with direct code citations
Reproduction attempted against both the shared test DB and a freshly created+migrated DB

result.summary: Root cause CONFIRMED as architecturally real (Migrations.runForSchema sets search_path once, session-level, outside any transaction, and relies on holding one connection exclusively for the whole function) but NOT empirically reproducible against current main HEAD after 40 repro attempts (18 solo + 12 concurrent-process runs on the shared DB, 10 solo runs on a freshly created+migrated DB) -- 0/40 failed. Most likely explanation: GH #424/ISS-0131 (a concurrently-merged fix from another workspace, commit 9512c69) added a session-level advisory lock around the whole provisionTenantSchema() call, incidentally narrowing/eliminating the interleaving ISS-0130 depends on. Also discovered and fixed incidentally: ISS-0208/GH #532, a pre-existing botched-merge compile error in tests/integration/effects_subsystem_test.zig that blocked obtaining any zig build test-integration baseline; fixed inline (BLOCKER, was preventing all acceptance-criteria verification) and filed as its own issue. Also discovered (not fixed, pre-existing, non-blocking): shared bpm_test container has 8 leaked tenant fixture rows causing schema baseline drift; worked around by using a freshly created database for measurement per anti-patterns.md guidance.
result.next_action: Route to CODE-DESIGNER / BACKEND-DEV (Step 2/3) to apply systemic SET LOCAL search_path hardening in Migrations.runForSchema per diagnosis chosen_fix
